title: Power
description: Duty cycling for a device on a battery: wake, publish, deep-sleep, again. Off by default — a sleeping device is reachable only for the few seconds it is awake, plus a window after every power-on or update.

keys.name: mode
keys.title: Mode
keys.description: off: the device stays awake. cycle: after each wake it publishes, flushes the SignalK stream and deep-sleeps for the interval below. Takes effect immediately, but never while an update is still unconfirmed.

keys.name: interval_s
keys.title: Sleep between wakes
keys.description: How long the device sleeps before it wakes to publish again.

keys.name: window_s
keys.title: Awake window after power-on
keys.description: After a power-on, an update or a crash the device stays awake this long before the cycle starts, so its web UI and OTA can be reached. Cutting the power always reopens this window.

keys.name: awake_max_s
keys.title: Longest wake
keys.description: A wake that has not finished by then sleeps anyway — a network that never comes up must not drain the battery. Application holds do not extend it.

keys.name: publish_ms
keys.title: Time connected before sleeping
keys.description: Once the SignalK stream is connected (or, without SignalK, the network is up), the device stays awake this long so the application's values go out.

keys.name: flush_ms
keys.title: Flush timeout
keys.description: How long to wait for buffered deltas to be sent before sleeping.
